title: Galaxium
description: A spiral galaxy of forty thousand stars, spun and lit entirely on the GPU through WebGPU and TSL — arms, bulge and turbulence are all one shader graph, no CPU per-star math. Drag to orbit, scroll to dive toward the core, and it keeps drifting on its own the moment you let go.
intent: Pairs an instrument-style tuning panel with one strong GPU mechanic and a soft core glow, the optical-halo touch Herb keeps reaching for.
